description: This PHP class defines a data model 'EmployeeSalaryModel' for serializing employee salary information within the OrangeHRM system's PIM API. It employs traits and annotations for API schema documentation, and encapsulates properties related to employee salary including pay period, grade, currency, and direct debit details.

classes.name: EmployeeSalaryModel
classes.description: A serializable model representing employee salary data, including pay period, grades, currency, and direct debit information, suitable for API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EmployeeSalaryModel with an EmployeeSalary entity, setting filters and attribute names for serialization.
